messages:
Eli: Noticing weird token delta for streaming sessions after client truncation: UI shows ~30% fewer tokens than billing ledger for some sessions. Anyone else?
Priya: Which route / sample trace?
Eli: trace=trc-77ee, shard=eu-west-1, router=stable. Logs:
Eli: ```
[2026-03-23T09:02:11Z] session=trc-77ee start stream
[2026-03-23T09:02:12Z] session=trc-77ee client-truncate offset=120
[2026-03-23T09:02:12Z] session=trc-77ee retry toolcall=tc-900 created (idempotency key missing)
[2026-03-23T09:02:13Z] session=trc-77ee ack received chunk=120 ledger-tag=null
```
Sam: toolcall without idempotency can create duplicate meter entries on reconnect. Maybe router assigns ledger tag only on toolcall confirmation, but chunk acks happened twice? :thinking: 
Jorge: Quick query to find suspects:
Jorge: ```sql
SELECT session_id, count(distinct toolcall_id) as tcs, sum(case when confirmed=0 then 1 else 0 end) as unconfirmed
FROM toolcall_events
WHERE timestamp > '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY session_id HAVING unconfirmed > 0 AND tcs > 1;
```
Priya: ops-bot alert fired: "billing-variance: stream_unconfirmed_delta > 5%"
ops-bot: incident INC-7662 created, assigned to @oncall
Eli: Proposal (short-term): treat toolcall-created-but-unconfirmed as provisional and don't reconcile to ledger until confirmation. Long-term: attach ledger_tag at router handoff earlier and enforce idempotency for client toolcalls.
Sam: small patch idea: router should propagate idempotency and pre-attach meter tag on client-truncate path. Diff idea:
Sam: ```go
if v := req.Header.Get("X-Idempotency"); v != "" {
 req.Header.Set("X-Meter-Idemp", v)
}
if req.Header.Get("X-Client-Truncate") != "" {
 // pre-attach ledger tag so acks later are attributed
 req.Header.Set("X-Meter-Tag", allocateLedgerTag())
}
```
Priya: Need tests for proxy/reconnect path (proxy sometimes strips headers). Also update ledger reconciliation to group by (session, idempotency_key) when present.
Eli: I'll open the PR. Can we also add a temporary dashboard panel "streaming_unconfirmed_ratio" and alert at 2%? @ops-bot pls.
Jorge: panel created, linked to INC-7662, threshold 2%. Added trace link column for toolcall ids.
ops-bot: @support requested console change: show provisional flag on token breakdown and surface toolcall ids in traces.
Priya: +1 to console UX change. Helps CS and oncall.
Sam: Timeline: PR -> canary -> monitor 1h -> rollback if spikes persist. Anyone object?
Jorge: no objections, tagging for postmortem.
Eli: Thanks team — keeping thread for notes. :sparkles:
